name: ui-ux-kit
description: UI and UX design craft skills for building and reviewing websites and app screens: Impeccable and Hallmark for design direction and polish, Vercel Web Interface Guidelines for review, redesign of existing projects, purposeful interface animation, motion design, and the ui-review-loop method with Playwright capture and audit scripts for mobile first QA.

author.name: James Kim (packaged from open source skills, plus a review method from the Polyquest and Cojam builds)
